name: GLM-4.6: Advanced Agentic, Reasoning and Coding
snippet:
Sep 30, 2025 — GLM-4.6 shows a clear improvement in reasoning performance and supports tool use during inference, leading to stronger overall capability.
Results show clear gains over GLM-4.5, with GLM-4.6 also holding competitive advantages over leading domestic and international models such as DeepSeek-V3.2-Exp and Claude Sonnet 4, but still lags behind Claude Sonnet 4.5 in coding ability.
